label: order-change-policy-v3-targeted-2026-11-16-e
authorization: Apply every existing-order change => Urgent and manager review, including proposed/question-form/conditional changes. Verify both inputs and saves; necessary targeted only; preserve failed runs; no full30; stop first failure.
scope: Minimal shared classifier clarification plus deterministic priority override in existing main logged priority and helper actual priority. Existing manager-review rules already cover Support/change flag and stay unchanged; no new model output, schema, node, connection or draft policy.

replacements.old: Set record_change_requested to true when the sender asks the business to change or update stored information, including a customer contact, account information, payment information, or an existing order or production instruction.
replacements.new: Set record_change_requested=true for requested, proposed, conditional or question-form changes to an existing order or production instruction, including artwork/images, wording, quantity, specifications, timing, pickup, delivery, holds or cancellation. Classify identifiable existing-order changes as Support. Do not require an explicit deadline or a confirmed production schedule. Also set record_change_requested=true for changes to stored customer, contact, account or payment information, retaining the appropriate business category.

replacements.old: A request merely asking for information does not by itself count as a record change.
replacements.new: Ordinary product, pricing or options inquiries unconnected to changing an existing order do not by themselves set record_change_requested=true. A request or question about changing an existing order does count; missing essential details still require the existing context safeguards and manager review.

replacements.old: Use Urgent only when the actual message contains genuine near-term time pressure requiring prompt attention, such as action needed today, within hours, before an imminent deadline, or for a problem affecting tomorrow.
replacements.new: ORDER-CHANGE POLICY V3: When category="Support" and record_change_requested=true, priority is Urgent regardless of the stated timing. The workflow independently enforces Urgent and manager review for identified order changes; do not guess when production will happen. For other messages, use Urgent when the supplied record establishes genuine near-term time pressure requiring prompt attention.

replacements.old: Words such as "urgent," "ASAP," or similar language by themselves do not make a message Urgent when the actual timing is later, routine, or unclear.
replacements.new: Outside the order-change rule, words such as "urgent," "ASAP," or similar language alone do not make a message Urgent when the actual timing is later, routine, or unclear.

stop_rule: Each listed case once in order. Raw model priority is diagnostic, not an order-change pass gate: effective saved-rule priority and manager review are the criteria. Stop further model calls at first recognition, typed-output or effective-routing failure; no tuning/retry/full30. Preserve failed candidate. Do not deploy a failed candidate.
verification: Execute exact read-back expressions offline on actual classifier responses; review existing predicates; inspect both flow inputs; Save/checker. No fresh Outlook/Dataverse/workflow runtime claim unless actually executed. No old scores rescored; no owner ratings assigned.
preservation: Versioned prospective business policy. V1/v2 key/scorers/contracts and prior FAILs unchanged. Raw classification.priority retained separately from effective priority in helper output. Do not use v2 scorer unchanged for v3; it requires raw/effective priority equality.
